reference_sql:
WITH ranked AS (  -- one row per order of a known customer
  SELECT o.customer_id, s.store_code,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.customer_id ORDER BY o.order_ts DESC, o.order_id) AS rn
  FROM orders o
  JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  WHERE o.customer_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT store_code, COUNT(*) AS customers
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY store_code
alternatives:
WITH latest AS (  -- one row per known customer
  SELECT customer_id, MAX(order_ts) AS order_ts
  FROM orders
  WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
latest_ids AS (  -- one row per known customer
  SELECT o.customer_id, MIN(o.order_id) AS order_id
  FROM orders o
  JOIN latest l ON l.customer_id = o.customer_id AND l.order_ts = o.order_ts
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
)
SELECT s.store_code, COUNT(*) AS customers
FROM latest_ids li
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = li.order_id
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
GROUP BY s.store_code

SELECT t.store_code, COUNT(*) AS customers
FROM (
  -- one row per order of a known customer, numbered from the latest
  SELECT o.customer_id, s.store_code,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.customer_id ORDER BY o.order_ts DESC, o.order_id) AS rn
  FROM orders o
  JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  WHERE o.customer_id IS NOT NULL
) AS t
WHERE t.rn = 1
GROUP BY t.store_code

  WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
latest_ids AS (  -- one row per known customer
  SELECT o.customer_id, MIN(o.order_id) AS order_id
  FROM orders o
  JOIN latest l ON l.customer_id = o.customer_id AND l.order_ts = o.order_ts
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
)
SELECT s.store_code, COUNT(*) AS customers
FROM latest_ids li
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = li.order_id
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
GROUP BY s.store_code
other_way.tradeoff: The latest time per customer, then the lowest order_id at it, needs no window but takes two grouping steps and a join back.

solver.query:
WITH r AS (SELECT o.store_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.customer_id ORDER BY o.order_ts DESC, o.order_id) AS rn FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id IS NOT NULL)
SELECT s.store_code, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM r JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = r.store_id WHERE r.rn = 1 GROUP BY s.store_code
